correctness.rationale: Pinned RESULT.md and both explicit verifier sources define 32 dual triangular cells, 41 usable rhombi, 50 perfect matchings. Independent exhaustive plane-partition enumeration generated 50 facets, 2,517,788 faces including empty, exact complete f-vector, and validated all nine ordered pivot-pair matching stages with counts (1011305,247522,30,26,3,3,1,1,1), leaving exactly one 0-face and two dimension-four critical simplices (masks 16777216, 2155873346, 137439215754). Stagewise element pairing is acyclic by the earliest-pivot invariant, including later-stage unmatched sets; Forman gives a CW with 0-cell and two 4-cells, hence S4∨S4. The exhaustive finite set is fully enumerated, not extrapolated to larger honeycombs.
residual_risks: A finite exhaustive computation proves this instance, not an extension to larger honeycombs.
